title: What a typo looks like
prompt: What does this return? Read it — do not run it.

given.script:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map {name: $.fullName, age: $.age, city: $.city}

solution:
%dw 2.0
output application/json
---
payload map {name: $.fullName, age: $.age, city: $.city}

explanation.approach: `$.fullName` does not exist, so it becomes null. No compilation error, no warning — the mapping just silently drops the name. This is why the first hint says a typo ships silently.
